stem: What happens next in this passage after “Visitors can go there after reading, but they must stay on the paths.”?
options: A student group visited the roof for a science report.
A student group studied the street for a science project.

A group of students visited a recycling center for their science class.

本文沒有陳述「A student group studied the street for a science project.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
